name: Ama Tsumugu Norito
source:
People and gods live alongside each other, but gods start to lose their meaning. God hunters show up to destroy old gods.
Main character is born in such family and continues god hunting tradition even though the reason for it is drowned in time. One encounter with a girl makes him doubt his ideals.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人与神明共同生活，神明的意义却逐渐消失。猎神者随之出现，开始摧毁古老的神祇。
主人公出生于这样的家族。尽管猎神的缘由早已湮没于时间长河，他仍继承了这项传统。一次与某个女孩的邂逅，让他开始怀疑自己的信念。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
